scripts.jupyter: cross-env-shell PYTHONPATH=$INIT_CWD uv run --env-file .env jupyter lab --SQLiteYStore.db_path=$INIT_CWD/.venv/jupyter_ystore.db --YDocExtension.session_store_path=$INIT_CWD/.venv/collaboration_sessions.json
scripts.jupyverse: cross-env-shell PYTHONPATH=$INIT_CWD uv run --env-file .env jupyverse --set frontend.collaborative=true --set kernels.require_yjs=true --set jupyterlab.server_side_execution=true
